_about: The numbers and messages the help quotes, each with what produces it; backend/tests/test_docs.py checks them (LRN-12). A fact's text must be on its page; its expr, formatted with its format, must give a text inside it, or be true.

facts.text: the run ends as *success* with *Consumption* 11.11 kWh/100 km
*Distance driven* 7.292 km
final SOC, 88.76 %
*Consumption* reads 12.34 kWh/100 km
*+1.22 (+11.0 %) vs baseline*
the run ends as *success*, and the headline numbers read *Consumption* 14.05 kWh/100 km
*Distance driven* 23.267 km.
*Consumption* still reads 14.05 kWh/100 km
falls from 84.93 % to 82.12 %
facts.expr: (v('bev-wltc', 'HV Battery Pack — final SOC'), v('bev-wltc-40', 'HV Battery Pack — final SOC'))

facts.text: lists 5 errors, among them *Vehicle present but no connected wheels — it will not move*
facts.expr: count('first-car@parts', 'error') == 5 and check('first-car@parts', 'Vehicle present but no connected wheels — it will not move', 'error')

facts.text: now lists 2 errors, both about missing signals, such as *Driver 'Driver 1' has no Target Speed signal*
facts.expr: count('first-car@wired', 'error') == 2 and check('first-car@wired', "Driver 'Driver 1' has no Target Speed signal", 'error')

facts.text: has no errors left, and one warning: *Wheel load shares add up to 25 %, not 100 %*
facts.expr: count('first-car@signals', 'error') == 0 and count('first-car@signals', 'warning') == 1 and check('first-car@signals', 'Wheel load shares add up to 25 %, not 100 %', 'warning')

facts.text: *Problems* says *All data checks passed*
facts.expr: clear('first-car@share') and check('first-car@share', 'All data checks passed', 'info')

facts.text: the run ends as *success* with *Distance driven* 23.267 km
*Consumption* should be between 9.5 and 11.5 kWh/100 km
LightSim gives 10.46 kWh/100 km with the values above
Your car uses 10.46 kWh/100 km on the WLTC, the example 14.05: 26 % less
facts.format: {0[0]:.2f} kWh/100 km on the WLTC, the example {0[1]:.2f}: {0[2]:.0f} % less

facts.expr: (v('bev-city', 'Consumption'), v('bev-city', 'Distance driven'), v('bev-city', 'HV Battery Pack — final SOC'))
(v('bev-wltc', 'Consumption'), v('bev-wltc', 'Distance driven'), v('bev-wltc', 'HV Battery Pack — final SOC'))

facts.text: *WLTC, heating/air-con on* | 18.88 kWh/100 km | 23.267 km | 83.19 % |
facts.expr: (v('bev-wltc-hvac', 'Consumption'), v('bev-wltc-hvac', 'Distance driven'), v('bev-wltc-hvac', 'HV Battery Pack — final SOC'))

facts.text: *WLTC, winter day (−7 °C, heating on)* | 23.76 kWh/100 km | 23.267 km | 81.43 % |
facts.expr: (v('bev-wltc-winter', 'Consumption'), v('bev-wltc-winter', 'Distance driven'), v('bev-wltc-winter', 'HV Battery Pack — final SOC'))
facts.format: *WLTC, winter day (−7 °C, heating on)* | {0[0]:.2f} kWh/100 km | {0[1]:.3f} km | {0[2]:.2f} % |

facts.text: *WLTC, hot day (35 °C, air-con on)* | 16.76 kWh/100 km | 23.267 km | 83.95 % |
facts.expr: (v('bev-wltc-summer', 'Consumption'), v('bev-wltc-summer', 'Distance driven'), v('bev-wltc-summer', 'HV Battery Pack — final SOC'))

facts.text: PTC heater draws 4.25 kW the whole cycle
facts.format: PTC heater draws {0:.2f} kW the whole cycle

facts.text: its air-conditioning draws 1.39 kW
*Consumption* stays at 14.05 kWh/100 km and the final SOC falls from 84.93 % to 82.12 %
facts.expr: (v('bev-wltc-40', 'Consumption'), v('bev-wltc', 'HV Battery Pack — final SOC'), v('bev-wltc-40', 'HV Battery Pack — final SOC'))
facts.format: {0[0]:.2f} kWh/100 km and the final SOC falls from {0[1]:.2f} % to {0[2]:.2f} %

facts.text: **0 to 589 s, Low phase.**
**589 to 1,022 s, Medium phase.**
**1,022 to 1,477 s, High phase.** Main roads up to about 97 km/h
facts.format: **{0[1]:,.0f} to {0[2]:,.0f} s, {0[0]} phase.** Main roads up to about {0[3]:.0f} km/h

facts.text: **1,477 to 1,800 s, Extra High phase.** Motorway up to 131 km/h
*EPA city (UDDS)* | 2.83 l/100 km | 66.8 g/km | 11.99 km |
*EPA highway (HWFET)* | 3.23 l/100 km | 76.2 g/km | 16.507 km |
*Mixed Cycle* | 2.87 l/100 km | 67.8 g/km | 9.556 km |
Over the whole cycle the engine starts 31 times

facts.expr: (v('hy-udds', 'Fuel consumption'), v('hy-udds-12v', 'Fuel consumption'), 100 * (v('hy-udds-12v', 'Fuel consumption') / v('hy-udds', 'Fuel consumption') - 1))

facts.text: 3.23 to 3.27 l/100 km, about 1 % more
facts.expr: (v('hy-hwfet', 'Fuel consumption'), v('hy-hwfet-200', 'Fuel consumption'), 100 * (v('hy-hwfet-200', 'Fuel consumption') / v('hy-hwfet', 'Fuel consumption') - 1))

facts.text: At a steady 80 km/h they cost no fuel at all
In the city: 2.83 against 3.23 l/100 km
facts.format: In the city: {0[0]:.2f} against {0[1]:.2f} l/100 km

facts.text: From 0.37 s.** The Accumulator reaches 80 kW
facts.expr: message('fs-accel', 'held at its Output Power Limit (80 kW at the terminals) from t = 0.37 s')

facts.text: **From about 1.9 s.** The rear tyres grip again
facts.expr: 0.01 * v('fs-accel', "Time at the tyres' grip limit") * v('fs-accel', 'Simulated duration')
facts.format: **From about {:.1f} s.** The rear tyres grip again

facts.text: **3.75 s.** The car crosses the 75 m line at 119 km/h
facts.format: **{0[0]:.2f} s.** The car crosses the 75 m line at {0[1]:.0f} km/h

facts.text: 3.751 s from the start line, 118.89 km/h at the line, 0-100 km/h in 2.95 s
facts.expr: (v('fs-accel', 'Time to 75 m'), v('fs-accel', 'Speed at 75 m'), v('fs-accel', 'Time to 100 km/h'))
facts.format: {0[0]:.3f} s from the start line, {0[1]:.2f} km/h at the line, 0-100 km/h in {0[2]:.2f} s

facts.text: 57.721 s for the flying lap, 60.31 km/h average
facts.format: {0[0]:.3f} s for the flying lap, {0[1]:.2f} km/h average

facts.text: 1,428.53 s, 5.33 kWh net from the Accumulator, 25.02 % SOC left
facts.expr: (v('fs-endurance', 'Total time'), v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — energy delivered') - v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — energy recuperated'), v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — final SOC'))
facts.format: {0[0]:,.2f} s, {0[1]:.2f} kWh net from the Accumulator, {0[2]:.2f} % SOC left

facts.text: 3.751 to 4.231 s, 0.481 s slower, and 95.94 km/h at the line instead of 118.89 km/h
facts.expr: (v('fs-accel', 'Time to 75 m'), v('fs-accel-40', 'Time to 75 m'), v('fs-accel-40', 'Time to 75 m') - v('fs-accel', 'Time to 75 m'), v('fs-accel-40', 'Speed at 75 m'), v('fs-accel', 'Speed at 75 m'))
facts.format: {0[0]:.3f} to {0[1]:.3f} s, {0[2]:.3f} s slower, and {0[3]:.2f} km/h at the line instead of {0[4]:.2f} km/h

facts.text: 3.751 to 4.026 s. The car spends 64.1 % of the run at the tyres' grip limit instead of 48.6 %
facts.expr: (v('fs-accel', 'Time to 75 m'), v('fs-accel-mu13', 'Time to 75 m'), v('fs-accel-mu13', "Time at the tyres' grip limit"), v('fs-accel', "Time at the tyres' grip limit"))
facts.format: {0[0]:.3f} to {0[1]:.3f} s. The car spends {0[2]:.1f} % of the run at the tyres' grip limit instead of {0[3]:.1f} %

facts.text: The car needs 1,454.700 s instead of 1,428.53 s (26 s more) and ends with 34.16 % SOC instead of 25.02 %
facts.expr: (v('fs-endurance-25', 'Total time'), v('fs-endurance', 'Total time'), v('fs-endurance-25', 'Total time') - v('fs-endurance', 'Total time'), v('fs-endurance-25', 'Accumulator — final SOC'), v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — final SOC'))
facts.format: The car needs {0[0]:,.3f} s instead of {0[1]:,.2f} s ({0[2]:.0f} s more) and ends with {0[3]:.2f} % SOC instead of {0[4]:.2f} %

facts.text: *Time to 75 m* 3.751 s and *Speed at 75 m* 118.89 km/h
facts.format: *Time to 75 m* {0[0]:.3f} s and *Speed at 75 m* {0[1]:.2f} km/h

facts.text: *Gap to reference time* is -0.159 s
*Time at the tyres' grip limit* reads 48.6 %
facts.expr: v('fs-accel', "Time at the tyres' grip limit")

facts.text: *held at the output power limit* for 3.61 s
facts.expr: v('fs-accel', 'Accumulator — time held at the output power limit')

facts.text: held at 80 kW from t = 0.37 s
facts.expr: message('fs-accel', 'held at its Output Power Limit (80 kW at the terminals) from t = 0.37 s')

facts.text: from the launch until about 1.9 s the rear tyres spin at their grip limit
facts.expr: 0.01 * v('fs-accel', "Time at the tyres' grip limit") * v('fs-accel', 'Simulated duration')
facts.format: until about {:.1f} s the rear tyres spin

facts.text: From about 1.9 s to the line the 80 kW limit sets the pace
facts.expr: 0.01 * v('fs-accel', "Time at the tyres' grip limit") * v('fs-accel', 'Simulated duration')
facts.format: From about {:.1f} s to the line

facts.text: 4.231 s at 40 kW, 4.039 s at 50 kW, 3.909 s at 60 kW, 3.82 s at 70 kW and 3.751 s at 80 kW
facts.expr: tuple(v(r, 'Time to 75 m') for r in ('fs-accel-40', 'fs-accel-50', 'fs-accel-60', 'fs-accel-70', 'fs-accel'))

facts.text: below about 60 kW the car is slower than the median team
facts.expr: v('fs-accel-50', 'Gap to reference time') > 0 and v('fs-accel-60', 'Gap to reference time') < 0

facts.text: the time rises from 3.751 s to 4.026 s, and *Time at the tyres' grip limit* from 48.6 % to 64.1 %
facts.expr: (v('fs-accel', 'Time to 75 m'), v('fs-accel-mu13', 'Time to 75 m'), v('fs-accel', "Time at the tyres' grip limit"), v('fs-accel-mu13', "Time at the tyres' grip limit"))
facts.format: from {0[0]:.3f} s to {0[1]:.3f} s, and *Time at the tyres' grip limit* from {0[2]:.1f} % to {0[3]:.1f} %

facts.text: the run ends as *success* after 1,428.53 s (*Total time*), 22.515 km driven, with *Accumulator — final SOC* 25.02 %
facts.expr: status('fs-endurance') == 'success' and (round(v('fs-endurance', 'Total time'), 2), round(v('fs-endurance', 'Distance driven'), 3), round(v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — final SOC'), 2)) == (1428.53, 22.515, 25.02)

facts.text: 6.5 kWh delivered and 1.167 kWh recuperated: 5.33 kWh net, and *Energy per lap* 0.2319 kWh. Braking gives back 18 % of the energy drawn
facts.expr: (v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — energy delivered'), v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — energy recuperated'), v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — energy delivered') - v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — energy recuperated'), v('fs-endurance', 'Energy per lap'), 100 * v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — energy recuperated') / v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — energy delivered'))
facts.format: {0[0]:.1f} kWh delivered and {0[1]:.3f} kWh recuperated: {0[2]:.2f} kWh net, and *Energy per lap* {0[3]:.4f} kWh. Braking gives back {0[4]:.0f} % of the energy drawn

facts.text: *RMS battery power* reads 22.853 kW, and the accumulator was held at its limit for 703.27 s, about half the event
facts.expr: (v('fs-endurance', 'RMS battery power'), v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — time held at the output power limit'), 0.45 < v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — time held at the output power limit') / v('fs-endurance', 'Total time') < 0.55)
facts.format: *RMS battery power* reads {0[0]:.3f} kW, and the accumulator was held at its limit for {0[1]:.2f} s, about half the event

facts.text: *Accumulator — minimum pack voltage* is 472.94 V
*Time limited by power cap* reads 703.266 s and *Time limited by cornering grip* 434.603 s
facts.expr: (v('fs-endurance', 'Time limited by power cap'), v('fs-endurance', 'Time limited by cornering grip'))
facts.format: *Time limited by power cap* reads {0[0]:.3f} s and *Time limited by cornering grip* {0[1]:.3f} s

facts.text: the *Total time* is 1,454.700 s at 25 kW, 1,428.53 s at 30 kW and 1,407.638 s at 35 kW; the final SOC 34.16 %, 25.02 % and 16.44 %
facts.expr: tuple(v(r, 'Total time') for r in ('fs-endurance-25', 'fs-endurance', 'fs-endurance-35')) + tuple(v(r, 'Accumulator — final SOC') for r in ('fs-endurance-25', 'fs-endurance', 'fs-endurance-35'))
facts.format: the *Total time* is {0[0]:,.3f} s at 25 kW, {0[1]:,.2f} s at 30 kW and {0[2]:,.3f} s at 35 kW; the final SOC {0[3]:.2f} %, {0[4]:.2f} % and {0[5]:.2f} %

facts.text: Each 5 kW more saves 21 to 26 s over the event and uses about 9 points more charge
facts.expr: (v('fs-endurance', 'Total time') - v('fs-endurance-35', 'Total time'), v('fs-endurance-25', 'Total time') - v('fs-endurance', 'Total time'), (v('fs-endurance-25', 'Accumulator — final SOC') - v('fs-endurance-35', 'Accumulator — final SOC')) / 2)
facts.format: saves {0[0]:.0f} to {0[1]:.0f} s over the event and uses about {0[2]:.0f} points

facts.text: accumulator reached its minimum SOC (5 %) at t = 1326 s, and the car stops 347 m into lap 23
facts.expr: status('fs-endurance-3p') == 'failed' and message('fs-endurance-3p', 'reached minimum SOC (5 %) at t = 1326 s') and message('fs-endurance-3p', 'stops 347 m into lap 23')

facts.text: With 4 the car finishes with 25.02 % SOC and 1.34 kWh usable energy left; with 5, 41.04 % and 3.075 kWh
facts.expr: (v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — final SOC'), v('fs-endurance', 'Accumulator — usable energy left'), v('fs-endurance-5p', 'Accumulator — final SOC'), v('fs-endurance-5p', 'Accumulator — usable energy left'))
facts.format: With 4 the car finishes with {0[0]:.2f} % SOC and {0[1]:.2f} kWh usable energy left; with 5, {0[2]:.2f} % and {0[3]:.3f} kWh
